panels.description: bam_enabled is a boolean operator toggle: 1 when BAM is enabled, 0 when disabled. The panel takes the max across the selected instance(s) to show whether BAM is enabled anywhere.
panels.title: BAM Enabled

panels.description: Current BAM transport/auth/config/heartbeat health (bam_healthy). Max across the selected instance(s) returns 1 when at least one BAM client is healthy in that sense; it does not imply current-slot BAM freshness.
panels.title: BAM Healthy

panels.description: Current BAM scheduler stream live state (bam_stream_live). Max across the selected instance(s) returns 1 when at least one BAM scheduler gRPC stream is established and live, 0 otherwise.
panels.title: BAM Stream Live

panels.description: Current BAM healthy takeover state. Max across the selected instance(s) returns 1 when at least one BAM client is healthy enough to own TPU ingress, 0 otherwise.
panels.title: BAM Healthy

panels.description: Raw BAM control gauges over time. Compare bam_healthy and bam_stream_live directly to see when BAM became healthy enough to own TPU ingress.
panels.title: BAM Control Timeline

panels.description: Healthy connection lifecycle and keepalive acknowledgment activity. bam_healthy_connects and bam_healthy_disconnects count transitions into and out of bam_healthy transport/auth/config/heartbeat health; slot-end outcomes are tracked separately by bam_healthy_leader_slot_result. bam_keepalive_acks counts HTTP/2 keepalive PING acknowledgments received from the BAM node.
panels.title: BAM Healthy Connects and Keepalive ACKs

panels.description: Heartbeat exchange with the BAM node. bam_outbound_enqueue_outcome{bam_enqueue_outcome="heartbeat_enqueued"} counts validator heartbeat messages accepted by gRPC stream_send; bam_builder_heartbeats_decoded counts builder heartbeat messages successfully decoded, shown as rates.
panels.title: BAM Heartbeats

panels.description: HTTP/2 keepalive round-trip time in nanoseconds. The series are shown only after bam_keepalive_rtt_valid becomes 1, so startup zeroes do not appear as real RTT samples.
panels.title: BAM Keepalive RTT

panels.description: Per-second publish rate from BAM into verify. bam_transaction_published counts transactions published from BAM, including those unpacked from bundles, and bam_atomic_batch_published counts revert_on_error AtomicTxnBatch entries published into the pipeline.
panels.title: BAM Publish Rate

panels.description: Current number of BAM feedback results buffered for send (bam_feedback_queue_depth gauge). A rising value indicates feedback is falling behind.
panels.title: BAM Feedback Queue Depth

panels.description: Bundle backlog in pack. pack_available_transactions with avail_txn_type=bundles is the count of pending bundle transactions available to schedule; pack_pending_transactions_heap_size is the fixed capacity of pack's pending heap.
panels.title: Pack Bundle Backlog

panels.description: BAM tile workspace heap usage in bytes. bam_heap_size is total reserved capacity, bam_heap_free_bytes is estimated free space, and used is computed as size minus free.
panels.title: BAM Heap Usage

panels.description: Relative BAM node heartbeat arrival-delta distribution, computed from the builder heartbeat timestamp to Frankendancer scheduler-stream receive callback time. This includes remote clock offset/skew and is not network RTT.
panels.title: BAM Node Heartbeat Arrival Delta

panels.description: Scheduler Ping-to-Pong local send-boundary delay inside the BAM client, measured from Ping receive callback to local readiness classification or attempted Pong send on a live scheduler stream. No-live-stream cases are counted separately in bam_scheduler_pong_send_outcome.
panels.title: BAM Scheduler Pong Send Delay

panels.description: Drop rates from BAM ingest and feedback. bam_ingress_packet_oversize counts BAM packets rejected because their declared payload exceeded the local MTU; bam_feedback_results_dropped counts feedback results dropped because the local result queue was full.
panels.title: BAM Drops

panels.description: Per-second BAM control-plane and session failure rates grouped by bam_failure. bam_failure is a cumulative counter with disjoint auth_challenge_decode, config_decode, scheduler_envelope_decode, request_failed, resolve, connect, io, unsupported_version, request_timeout, keepalive_timeout, and builder_activity_timeout buckets. Batch and wrapper-level scheduler payload rejects stay in bam_ingress_batch_rejected and bam_ingress_message_rejected instead of bam_failure.
panels.title: BAM Failures (by class)

panels.description: Per-second bundle-related transaction failures through verify/dedup/resolh plus pack drops. verify_transaction_result and dedup_transaction_result use bundle_peer_failure result labels; resolh_transaction_bundle_peer_failure counts resolve-stage peer failures; pack_transaction_dropped_partial_bundle counts transactions dropped in pack because the bundle was partial. Failures are per-transaction even when the root cause is a bundle.
panels.title: Pipeline Bundle Peer Failures

panels.description: Per-second rate of bank execution results labeled transaction_error=bundle_peer. These are transactions that failed because a peer transaction in the same bundle failed (bank_transaction_result counter).
panels.title: Bank Bundle Peer Failures

panels.description: Per-second results of pack's bundle crank checks, grouped by bundle_crank_result: not_needed (on-chain state already correct), inserted (initializer bundle inserted), creation_failed, and insertion_failed.
panels.title: Bundle Crank Status

panels.description: Delay in starting the slot caused by loading data needed for bundle crank transactions.
panels.title: PoH Bundle Init Delay

panels.description: Rate (events/sec) of decoded multiple_atomic_txn_batch scheduler payloads. Builder-heartbeat traffic is shown in the dedicated BAM Heartbeats panel, so this panel isolates work-carrying ingress messages.
panels.title: BAM Ingress Work Messages

panels.description: Rate (events/sec) through the AtomicTxnBatch entry lifecycle: commit attempts, published entries, and batch-level rejected entries. Wrapper-message rejects are tracked separately in bam_ingress_message_rejected.
panels.title: BAM Ingress Batch Lifecycle

panels.description: Rate (events/sec) of BAM ingress rejects by reason. Batch-entry rejects use bam_ingress_batch_reject_reason; multiple_atomic_txn_batch wrapper rejects use bam_ingress_message_reject_reason.
panels.title: BAM Ingress Reject Reasons

panels.description: Total scheduler-stream live-state transitions over the selected time range, grouped by bam_stream_transition. down_to_live and live_to_down should usually remain close.
panels.title: BAM Stream Transitions (Range Count)

panels.description: Total pending leader-state updates cleared or superseded before send over the selected time range, grouped by bam_leader_pending_drop_reason. Healthy steady state is typically near zero; superseded indicates a newer pending leader-state replaced an older unsent one.
panels.title: BAM Leader Pending Clears/Replacements (Range Count)

panels.description: Successful BAM outbound sends over the selected time range, split by leader-state updates and bundle-result messages.
panels.title: BAM Successful Enqueues (Range Count)

panels.description: Rate (events/sec) of BAM outbound enqueue outcomes, grouped by bam_enqueue_outcome on bam_outbound_enqueue_outcome. The `leader_state_enqueued` and `result_enqueued` buckets are the successful gRPC stream_send accepts; no_stream/enqueue_fail indicate skipped or failed enqueue attempts.
panels.title: BAM Enqueue Outcomes

panels.description: Rate (events/sec) of BAM scheduler stream live-state transitions, using bam_stream_transition.
panels.title: BAM Stream Transitions

panels.description: Rate (events/sec) of pending BAM leader-state updates cleared before send, split between explicit drops in bam_leader_pending_dropped and latest-value-wins replacements in bam_leader_pending_replaced.
panels.title: BAM Pending Leader Clears/Replacements

panels.description: Rate (events/sec) of in-progress BAM bundle assembly abandonment in pack, grouped by pack_bam_bundle_assembly_abandon_reason (new sequence preemption, slot-end transitions, or PoH timeout).
panels.title: Pack BAM Bundle Assembly Abandon (by reason)

panels.description: Rate (events/sec) of BAM work invalidated by slot/blockhash revalidation in pack, grouped by pack_bam_work_invalid_reason across single transactions and fully assembled bundles. This is the superset counter: it includes both pre-pending rejects and post-acceptance evictions.
panels.title: Pack BAM Work Revalidation (derived superset, by reason)

panels.description: Rate (events/sec) of BAM pending-work items that were accepted into pack, remained in the pending-work tracker, and were later evicted by slot/blockhash revalidation, grouped by pack_bam_work_invalid_reason. This is the post-acceptance subset of the derived rejects-plus-evictions superset panel above.
panels.title: Pack BAM Pending Work Evicted (post-acceptance, by reason)

panels.description: Current count of BAM work items that have been accepted into pack and are still tracked in pack's pending-work set, before schedule handoff or cleanup.
panels.title: Pack BAM Pending Work Count

panels.description: Rate (events/sec) of BAM transactions or fully assembled BAM bundles rejected by slot/blockhash revalidation before they were ever accepted into pack's pending-work tracker, grouped by pack_bam_work_invalid_reason.
panels.title: Pack BAM Rejected Pre-Pending (by reason)

panels.description: Rate (slots/sec) of healthy BAM-owned leader slots that ended after fresh current-slot BAM work arrived before slot end.
panels.title: Healthy BAM Fresh Slot Rate

panels.description: Rate (slots/sec) of healthy BAM-owned leader slots that ended without fresh current-slot BAM work arriving before slot end.
panels.title: Healthy BAM No-Fresh Slot Rate

panels.description: Rate (events/sec) of finalized BAM slot-ingress rollups, grouped by bam_slot_ingress_result: no_ingress, first_before_end, first_after_end, or unknown_slot_end.
panels.title: BAM Slot Ingress Results

panels.description: Rate (transactions/sec) in finalized BAM slot-ingress rollups, grouped by bam_slot_ingress_txn_timing: before_end, after_end, or unknown_slot_end.
panels.title: BAM Slot Ingress Transactions

panels.description: Rate (items/sec) of BAM work observed at each pack lifecycle stage. Multi-transaction BAM bundles count as one item, so this shows work-item flow rather than per-transaction volume.
panels.title: Pack BAM Work Items by Stage

panels.description: Current leader-slot signals that BAM forwards and pack currently believes. bam_leader_state_slot and bam_leader_state_tick come from pack->bam leader-state snapshots; pack_leader_slot is pack's local leader slot gauge.
panels.title: Leader Slot Signals

panels.description: Cross-check active slot timing assumptions. bam_leader_state_slot_end_nanos minus pack_leader_slot_end_nanos should stay near zero; pohh_slot_done_delay_seconds p50 gives the current local slot-length scale for interpreting that delta.
panels.title: Slot Timing Assumptions

panels.description: Rate (slots/sec) of finalized pack leader slots grouped by when the first BAM insert or first BAM schedule happened relative to slot end.
panels.title: Pack First BAM Insert/Schedule Results

panels.description: Per-second BAM gRPC client activity. bam_grpc_wakeups counts I/O polls, bam_grpc_requests_sent counts completed request-body sends, and bam_grpc_stream_chunks_tx/rx count DATA frames carrying outbound and inbound payload.
panels.title: BAM gRPC Activity

panels.description: Per-second BAM gRPC payload byte rate carried in HTTP/2 DATA frames.
panels.title: BAM gRPC Byte Rate

panels.description: Per-second BAM gRPC transport errors. Stream errors are survivable per-stream failures; connection errors terminate the transport.
panels.title: BAM gRPC Errors

panels.description: Current number of BAM gRPC streams that are not closed.
panels.title: BAM gRPC Active Streams

panels.description: Rate of cumulative BAM gRPC wait time accrual. A value of 1e9 means one second of aggregate wait accumulated per wall-clock second.
panels.title: BAM gRPC Wait Accrual

panels.description: Live BAM first-ingress state for the current leader slot. Exactly one bam_current_leader_slot_first_ingress_state bucket is 1: no_ingress, slot_end_unknown, before_end, or after_end.
panels.title: BAM Current Slot First Ingress State

panels.description: Rate (rejects/sec) of BAM work dropped because pack's tracked-work table was full. Work-item and transaction counts diverge when multi-transaction BAM bundles are rejected at admission.
panels.title: Pack BAM Tracking Rejected

panels.description: Distribution of BAM scheduler-arrival to first-outcome delay for work items, aggregated across the selected instance set. The paired pack_bam_work_first_outcome panel breaks down whether that first outcome was rejection, tracking rejection, eviction, scheduling, or bundle-assembly abandonment.
panels.title: Pack BAM Work RX to First Outcome

panels.description: Rate (events/sec) of BAM scheduler Ping-to-Pong send outcomes. Use this with the send-delay histogram to distinguish local send-boundary contention, successful enqueues, and unexpected send failures.
panels.title: BAM Scheduler Pong Send Outcomes

panels.description: Rate (events/sec) of the first recorded outcome for each BAM work item. This complements the first-outcome delay histogram by showing whether work first ended in pre-pending rejection, tracking rejection, eviction, scheduling, or bundle-assembly abandonment.
panels.title: Pack BAM Work First Outcomes
